fusions.name: Long-Armed Cuff
fusions.desc: A swing of the rod that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. It slows the target by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Dominance Display
fusions.desc: A roar across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 damage, stuns everything in it for 1 second and leaves it [Weakened] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Troop Challenge
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds. An ape fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Lese-Majesty
fusions.desc: When an enemy strikes you, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
